name: Level one Gents Salon , Barber shop
address: Oasis Tower - Sheikh Zayed Rd - Trade Center Second - DIFC - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

hours.hours: 9 AM to 12:30 PM, 1:10 PM to 12 AM

owner_description: Experience premium grooming at Dubai's top-rated barbershop. we offer expert haircuts , precision beard trims , luxury treatments , and the best friendly atmosphere. Walk in or Book your appointment today and leave looking your best .

reviews.author: Deepraj Chhetri
reviews.text:
I had a very bad experience at this salon. I clearly explained to the hairstylist that I wanted a clean taper fade but he didn’t listen to my instructions. He just picked up the clippers and started cutting my hair without paying attention to what I had asked for.

A professional hairstylist should know what they’re doing. Hair isn’t something you can just experiment with if he wasn’t confident or wasn’t interested in doing the haircut I requested he should have been honest instead of accepting the job and giving me a completely different haircut.

I’m extremely disappointed with the result. I honestly look like a giant thumb now because of how badly it was cut. This was one of the worst haircut experiences I’ve ever had.
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Deepraj, We’re sorry to hear that you were disappointed with your haircut. We always take our clients’ feedback seriously, and we would like to clarify a few points regarding what happened during your visit.
When you arrived, you initially requested the sides to be shortened to approximately 12mm or 9mm. Our hairstylist started with 12mm, and during the haircut you confirmed that the length was okay. You then requested a taper fade, which our hairstylist proceeded with while following your instructions step by step.

please contact us on 0567001660 and our management will take care of you .

Every appointment is an experience in itself. While my haircut remains relatively unchanged, I leave feeling completely transformed. It's a testament to the exceptional level of craftsmanship, attention to detail, impeccable service, and genuine hospitality that Amir and the team consistently provide.

The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance of comfort and cleanliness- It's rare to find a salon that delivers such consistency and excellence every single time.

Without question, one of the finest salon experiences in Dubai. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Alaa Batarseh
reviews.text:
I called to ask about the prices before my first visit. They told me 55 AED for a haircut, 45 AED for a beard trim, and 90 AED if I get both done together, no further details.

After finishing, I was initially asked to pay 145 AED, which surprised me as it was never mentioned before. When I questioned it, they said it was because my hair was longer, but this wasn’t communicated upfront.

They tried to put the blame on me, saying I should have asked about the price for long hair, even though I called specifically to confirm prices beforehand.

After insisting on the original price, they lowered it to 125 AED. It took a lot of back-and-forth and pressure, including comments about whether I had enough money, before I was finally allowed to pay the agreed 90 AED.

the lack of transparency, the unpleasant attitude, and the way I was treated left me disappointed. I hope the shop improves communication and customer respect to avoid similar issues in the future.
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear to clarify what happened, you did not mention that your hair was long when you called. The price you were quoted was the standard rate for short haircuts, which was clearly communicated. After completing the service, you insisted on paying less than the actual cost, despite the extra time and effort required for your long hair.

Our team treated you respectfully throughout, even though your attitude was confrontational and dismissive.

We always strive to deal with our clients transparently and respectfully, and we expect the same in return.
